name: mirage
text: Understood, and this is a bigger step than the loser block I shipped earlier. Plan: a bet shows in any scanner, and can be placed by hand, only if its type (sport, kind, side, price band) is rated 2 stars or more, meaning it has shown profit against Novig's closing price. Everything rated 0 or 1 star, which includes unproven types, gets hidden. I'll first count how many bets a day survive that, so you know how much action is left, and I'll keep a switch to put it back. It's logged as PP1. I haven't built it yet.
